# Welcome Consultancy

> India's premier Foreign Trade & DGFT advisory firm (10+ years, 500+ clients, 16 EXIM services).

## About

Welcome Consultancy helps Indian exporters and importers with DGFT licensing, customs compliance, and export incentive optimization. Phone: +91 98671 73397. Website: https://welcomeconsultancy.in

## Services

- [IEC Code Registration](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/services/import-export-code): Mandatory 10-digit DGFT import-export code.
- [Export Incentives (RoDTEP / RoSCTL / Duty Drawback)](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/services/export-incentives): Maximize embedded tax rebates on exports.
- [EPCG License](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/services/epcg-license): Zero-duty capital goods import with 6x export obligation.
- [Advance Licence](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/services/advance-licence): Duty-free raw material imports for export production.
- [Star Export House Certificate](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/services/export-house-certificate): DGFT Star Exporter status recognition.
- [RCMC Application](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/services/rcmc-application): Export Promotion Council membership.
- [Certificate of Origin](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/services/certificate-of-origin): Preferential & non-preferential COO issuance.
- [Class 3 Digital Signature](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/services/digital-signature): EXIM DSC for DGFT & ICEGATE.
- [AD Code Registration](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/services/ad-code-registration): Bank AD Code tagging across ICEGATE ports.
- [FSSAI Import/Export License](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/services/fssai-registration): Central FSSAI for food EXIM.
- [AEO Registration](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/services/aeo-registration): Authorized Economic Operator T1/T2/T3.
- [SIMS Registration](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/services/sims-registration): Steel and commodity import monitoring filings.
- [Health Certificate](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/services/health-certificate): Phytosanitary & health clearance for agri exports.
- [Interest Equalization Scheme](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/services/interest-equalization-scheme): Export credit interest subvention advisory.
- [REX Registration](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/services/rex-registration): EU/UK GSP self-certification of origin.
- [ICEGATE Registration](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/services/icegate-registration): Customs portal onboarding & e-SANCHIT.
